Name: Custom Bush Automate
Author: LeFauxMatt
Description:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/Ulr2XSt.png[/img]
Automate's built-in support for Custom Bush is very basic. Some custom bushes have support for dropping items of various quality as well as multiple items. Without this mod installed, Automate is only able to collect a single item with no quality.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/oszWv38.png[/img]
This mod enables Automate to have full compatibility for Custom Bush.
